sfx_review.note: Sits ~805 ms after the motion burst, at the right edge of the spectrogram window; no clear transient visible, and nothing happens visually at that moment. CLAP 'chime' at 0.425 is weak.

pattern.description: Headline swap: 'Everything is context' dims and drifts up out of frame while 'Universal Context™' rises from below and fades up to full white, overlapping briefly, on a dark background with a dotted waveform horizon.
pattern.why_premium: The overlapped vertical crossfade keeps one continuous upward motion vector, so the new product term feels like the answer to the previous line rather than a cut; short distance and fast ease-out keep it crisp.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(oldHeadline, {y: -40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo(newHeadline, {y: 40, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.1')
build_hint.remotion: Old: opacity and translateY driven by interpolate over ~9 frames (ease-in). New: spring({frame: frame - 3, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) mapped to translateY 40->0 and opacity 0->1 (no overshoot).

notes: Pattern is a headline-to-headline swap; kinetic_word_reveal is the nearest canonical id (alias kinetic-type-beats). The outgoing headline's manual box is an approximation. The waveform/dot horizon at the bottom appears static within this burst.
